name: Matera (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Matera (an ox beneath the letter M on blue) within branches, with the motto BOS LASSUS FIRMIUS FIGIT PEDEM on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Matera, a comune in Basilicata; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Matera arms — ox beneath the letter M on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto BOS LASSUS FIRMIUS FIGIT PEDEM
